pages.text: Health 30, Attack 4, Speed 0.3.$(br)Ancient undead whose flesh has long rotted away, roused by something unknown: soldiers that never forgot their craft, older and more dangerous than any dead adventurer - and crueller still under your hand.
You can summon these bone soldiers by ritual, or call them quickly with a $(l:supreme/items/second_rounder_osseous_focus)Second Rounder Osseous Focus$().
